title: The Corridor
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §6 (3.3: playable flashback as Ravi in the HIVR containment corridor, night; Appa calls; only 'Answer' is enabled, 'Ignore' greyed out; he skips the glove-change station; the screen doesn't dramatise it — a checklist shows one unticked box; the ant animation; 'Ours stops at the climbing part. In people, I mean. They don't die. They just... keep going.' Peak [Q]), outbreak_origin_v1 §1–2 (the agent mimics Ophiocordyceps; the merged chain: Ravi, distracted after the call, leaves a contaminated slide tray unsealed → Vikram cuts his hand on it → goes home feverish to his Malleswaram PG; one silent frame: next morning, Vikram's locker, his raincoat still dripping; the breach is in the player's first week, a rainy Thursday), 3.1 (AMR-07 overwritten at 02:14 by night_ops), 3.2 (Ravi's 'I answered'), ADR-11 (HIVR interiors are reveals), ADR-131 (locked choices are shown, never hidden). The user edits the words and the numbers; then P19 builds it.
time: Flashback: a rainy Thursday months ago (your first week in Bangalore), 01:52 → 02:14 at HIVR; then back to Ward 4 the same evening (18:30)
player_goal: Be Ravi for one night shift: walk the corridor, take the call, put the tray down.
design_goal: The peak of Act 3's quiet: the player causes the outbreak with their own hands and nothing dramatic happens. One choice that isn't a choice (Ignore is greyed out — you'd answer too), one station you walk past, one box left unticked. Then the ant: what the agent was built to do, and what it does in people. The guilt stays Ravi's, the understanding becomes the player's.

cast.role: After 'I answered' (ravi_ward_talked), talking to him again: 'You want to know?' → 'Tell me.' starts the flashback; 'Rest, Ravi.' leaves it for later (you can come back).
You play as Ravi: his sprite (npc_ravi, the green lanyard, the too-big shirt) replaces yours for this pocket only. No wallet, no phone apps of your own — his phone only rings.

On the phone, three lines: 'Ravi? Sorry, sorry, I know it's late. Your Amma's in the hospital again — no, don't come, it's nothing, it's the sugar. I just wanted to hear you.' Ravi: 'I'm at work, Appa. I'll call in the morning.' Appa: 'Eat something. You sound thin.'

beats.what: Ward 4, after 'I answered': 'You want to know?' → 'Tell me.' A card: 'HIVR · CONTAINMENT CORRIDOR · THURSDAY 01:52 — your first week in Bangalore. It was raining.' You are Ravi at the airlock. The HUD shows only the objective (no wallet, no clock of yours).

The corridor: cold light, a rain-streaked window, the clipboard on the wall (the night checklist: [x] Gown · [x] Mask · [x] Double gloves · [ ] Glove change at station B, before the slide room), the glove-change station halfway, the slide room at the end with tray AMR-07 under the hood.

Halfway down the corridor his phone buzzes: APPA. Two choices — Answer / Ignore — and Ignore is greyed out (locked, shown: 'It's Appa.'). The call, three lines. After it, the glove station: step to it and Ravi's thought cuts in — '(Your hands are shaking. After the tray.)' — and you walk on. The slide room: the tray goes down under the hood, unsealed. Nothing happens. The clipboard, once more: one unticked box.

Cut to the ant (a card sequence of four illustrated stills, documentary-plain, no gore): a spore on an ant's back → the ant climbs a grass stem, away from the colony → it clamps the underside of a leaf → a thin stalk grows from its head. Black. Ravi's voice over it: 'Ours stops at the climbing part. In people, I mean. They don't die. They just... keep going.' One silent frame: the next morning, a locker with a name strip (VIKRAM), a raincoat still dripping onto the floor. Back to Ward 4 at 18:30, Ravi asleep.

exits.note: in and out by card landings (ADR-137); the corridor has no door of its own

THE CORRIDOR: draft = one 12×8 pocket (airlock, corridor, glove station, slide room behind glass). Or a longer walk (two rooms)?
PLAYING AS RAVI: draft = his sprite as yours, HUD shows only the objective. Keep?
APPA'S CALL: draft = three lines (Amma in hospital again, 'don't come, it's the sugar', 'eat something, you sound thin'); Ignore shown greyed out with 'It's Appa.'. Words OK?
THE GLOVE STATION: draft = you can walk up to it but Ravi won't ('Your hands are shaking. After the tray.'). Or let the player change gloves — and the tray is unsealed anyway (the slip is elsewhere)?
THE CHECKLIST: draft = a clipboard on the wall, read as a card: [x] Gown · [x] Mask · [x] Double gloves · [ ] Glove change at station B. Keep the plain text-box look?
THE ANT: draft = four illustrated stills, documentary-plain, no gore (spore → climbs → clamps a leaf → a stalk from its head). Or an animated sprite?
VIKRAM: draft = only his locker the next morning (name strip VIKRAM, raincoat dripping) — no sprite, no line. Keep?
WHEN: draft = the card says 'your first week in Bangalore' (the breach timeline, outbreak_origin §2). Too on the nose, or keep?
THE RETURN: draft = back in Ward 4 at 18:30 the same day, Ravi asleep. Then 3.4 (three nights) starts from the ward bed. OK?
